shared_elements: incised linear details or striations on bodies/surface
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include profile animals rendered schematically with incised internal lines, and B may also include limb/hand-like motifs comparable only very generally to the hand beside the animal in A. The major difference is that A is a simple composition dominated by one raised quadruped next to an isolated hand, while B is a multi-register scene with many small animals, a patterned horizontal band, and complex stacked iconography.
